file-upload.$description: Dropzone and FileUploadItem (the logo-uploader block draws its drop target with them too). Component tokens reference SEMANTIC tokens through their CSS variables, so one declaration covers both themes. The drop target is a calm graphite well at rest; Qeet appears only while something is being dragged over it (the active state), and the danger roles only when it is invalid.

corner.$description: A drop target is a surface, not a control: the surface corner, one step above fields.

padding.$description: Drop-target padding, derived from the density-resolved field gap: 24px at default and comfortable density, 12px at compact.

border.$description: The dashed boundary at rest. The control boundary (≥3:1), because the drop target is an input, not decoration.

border-active.$description: While files are dragged over the target: the Qeet indicator role (≥3:1), so the active state never depends on the tint alone.

background.$description: The drop well at rest: the subtle surface, one quiet step off the card it sits on.

background-active.$description: While files are dragged over the target: the Qeet selected tint.

padding.$description: File-row padding, from the density-resolved field gap: 8px at default and comfortable density, 4px at compact.

background-error.$description: A failed row is the one that needs attention, so it alone is tinted; uploading and finished rows stay neutral.
